acili-ezme.subject: A small white meze bowl of Turkish acılı ezme, a finely minced almost paste-like bright red spicy salad of tomato, red pepper, onion and parsley glistening with pomegranate molasses and olive oil, no large chunks

fava.subject: A small white plate with a smooth firm slab of pale yellow Turkish fava broad bean purée cut into neat squares, drizzled with olive oil, garnished with chopped fresh dill, thin red onion rings and a lemon wedge

karisik-soguk-meze-tabagi.subject: A large white platter divided into six small portions of Turkish cold mezes: white garlic yogurt haydari, beige hummus, bright red acılı ezme, smoky eggplant salad, yellow fava slices and stuffed vine leaf sarma, drizzled with olive oil, no people

midye-dolma.subject: Five Turkish stuffed mussels midye dolma on a white plate, each black shell opened with the top shell lifted to show the spiced orange-brown rice with pine nuts and currants inside, lemon wedges between them

ciroz.subject: A small white plate of Turkish çiroz, dried mackerel flaked into thin golden-brown shreds, dressed with vinegar and olive oil, topped with plenty of chopped fresh dill and thin sliced green onion

karisik-sicak-meze-tabagi.subject: A large white platter of Turkish hot mezes: thin golden fried cheese cigar börek rolls, sliced fried paçanga börek, round green zucchini mücver fritters, golden fried calamari rings and a small clay dish of shrimp in tomato sauce, no vine leaves

pastirmali-humus.subject: A shallow white bowl of warm smooth hummus topped with a few thin translucent slices of dark ruby-red air-dried cured beef crisped in butter, toasted pine nuts and a drizzle of melted butter with paprika

pastirmali-kasarli-mantar.subject: A small round clay casserole dish of sautéed button mushrooms baked with thin translucent slices of dark ruby-red air-dried cured beef pieces and covered with melted bubbling golden cheese, chopped parsley on top

pacanga-boregi.subject: Turkish paçanga börek on a white plate, golden crispy fried yufka rolls cut diagonally into pieces, each cut end showing thin translucent slices of dark ruby-red air-dried cured beef, melted cheese and strips of roasted red pepper inside, a small bowl of yogurt dip

bazlama-tost.subject: A round thick fluffy Turkish bazlama flatbread toasted and cut in half, the halves stacked on a wooden board, golden griddle spots on the bread, melted cheese and slices of red sucuk sausage inside, tomato and pickles beside it

pastirmali-yumurta.subject: A round two-handled copper sahan pan with thin translucent slices of dark ruby-red air-dried cured beef slightly crisped in butter and two fried eggs with bright runny yolks on top, sliced white bread beside the pan

leblebi.subject: A small white ceramic bowl filled with Turkish yellow roasted chickpeas leblebi, round pale yellow smooth hulled chickpeas, no skins, no spices, a few scattered on the table beside the bowl

kofte-durum.subject: A Turkish köfte dürüm on a wooden board: a thin soft lavaş flatbread rolled tightly into a long wrap and cut in half diagonally, the cut end showing pieces of grilled köfte, tomato, onion with sumac, parsley and roasted green pepper, not a tortilla, a few pickles beside it

izgara-kofte.subject: A white plate with five flat oval Turkish grilled köfte patties, each about the size of a palm, thick and juicy with dark charred grill marks, not long finger-shaped, not round meatballs, served with a mound of white rice pilaf, two roasted green peppers, a grilled tomato and thin onion slices with sumac and parsley

ekmek-arasi-kavurma.subject: Half a loaf of crusty Turkish white bread split open lengthwise and stuffed with chunks of dark browned cubed beef kavurma glistening with fat, sliced tomato and roasted green pepper, black pepper on top, on a wooden board with a sheet of paper

kofte-ekmek.subject: Half a loaf of crusty Turkish white bread split open lengthwise and stuffed with four flat oval Turkish grilled köfte patties, each about the size of a palm, thick and juicy with dark charred grill marks, not long finger-shaped, not round meatballs, sliced tomato, onion with sumac and parsley and a roasted green pepper, on a wooden board with a sheet of paper

sutlac.subject: A small clear glass bowl of cold Turkish sütlaç rice pudding, smooth creamy pure white milky pudding with soft rice grains, dusted with ground cinnamon on top, not baked, no browned top

karisik-tost.subject: A Turkish pressed toastie cut diagonally into two triangles stacked on a white plate, golden toasted bread with grill press lines, smooth glossy melted pale yellow cheese, no strands, no noodles and round slices of dark red Turkish sucuk sausage, not pink visible at the cut, tomato slices and pickles on the side

karisik-omlet.subject: A folded fluffy golden three-egg omelette on a white plate, the fold open to show a filling of round slices of dark red Turkish sucuk sausage, not pink, melted kashar cheese, sliced mushrooms and green pepper, all yolks mixed, no fried eggs, tomato slices beside it

menemen.subject: A round two-handled copper sahan pan of Turkish menemen: soft creamy scrambled eggs fully mixed with cooked chopped tomato, green pepper and onion into one glossy red-orange mixture, no whole yolks, no fried eggs, no raw tomato slices, chili flakes on top, sliced white bread beside it

klasik-burger.subject: A classic beef burger on a wooden board: a toasted glossy brioche bun, a thick juicy grilled beef patty, crisp lettuce, tomato slices, pickles and burger sauce dripping, a side of straight-cut golden french fries

tavuklu-penne.subject: A wide shallow white bowl of penne in a creamy white sauce with grilled chicken pieces and sliced button mushrooms, sprinkled with fresh thyme and grated parmesan, a fork resting on the rim

sufle.subject: A small round chocolate lava cake soufflé on a white plate, cut open with a spoon so warm liquid dark chocolate flows out, dusted with powdered sugar, a scoop of vanilla ice cream beside it

ton-balikli-sandvic.subject: A ciabatta sandwich cut in half and stacked on a white plate, filled with creamy tuna salad with sweet corn and pickles, crisp lettuce and tomato slices, a small side of french fries

kasarli-tost.subject: A Turkish pressed toastie cut diagonally into two triangles stacked on a white plate, golden toasted white bread with grill press lines, thick smooth glossy melted pale yellow cheese, no strands, no noodles oozing at the cut, pickles beside it

kasarli-omlet.subject: A single folded fluffy golden three-egg omelette on a white plate, smooth glossy melted pale yellow cheese, no strands, no noodles oozing from the fold, sliced tomato beside it, only one omelette, no fried eggs

citir-kalamar-halkasi.subject: A white plate of golden crispy breadcrumb-coated calamari rings, clearly ring-shaped with holes, a small bowl of white tartar sauce and lemon wedges

levrek-izgara.subject: A whole grilled sea bass on a long white oval plate, silver skin with charred grill marks, head and tail intact, lemon slices, rocket leaves, thin red onion and grilled vegetables beside it

palamut-izgara.subject: Three thick round cross-cut steaks of grilled bonito fish on a white oval plate, each steak showing a ring of silvery-blue fish skin around firm pale pinkish-beige fish flesh with a central backbone, charred grill marks, thin red onion slices, rocket leaves and lemon wedges, clearly fish, not beef

iki-top-dondurma.subject: A small glass bowl with exactly two scoops of ice cream, one chocolate and one pistachio green, a wafer stick in between, only two scoops

cikolatali-gozleme.subject: A Turkish gözleme folded into a rectangle and cut in pieces on a wooden board, pale white yufka dough with brown griddle spots, the cut edges showing a filling of melted hazelnut chocolate spread, banana slices on the side, the dough itself is white not brown

acuka.subject: A small white meze bowl of acuka, a thick coarse deep red paste of red pepper paste, crushed walnuts and garlic, drizzled with olive oil, a few walnut halves on top

haslanmis-yumurta.subject: A peeled boiled egg cut in half on a small white plate, showing a firm white and a soft jammy orange yolk, sprinkled with salt and black pepper

mihlama-kuymak.subject: A small round copper pan of Turkish mıhlama: a smooth glossy molten yellow mixture of fine cornmeal cooked in butter, like a creamy cheesy polenta fondue, with melted stretchy white cheese pooled on top, a spoon lifting a long stretching string of cheese, no whole corn kernels, a basket of bread beside it

orgu-peyniri.subject: A small white plate with a braided rope of Turkish örgü peyniri white cheese, plaited and partly pulled into thin threads, sprinkled with black nigella seeds

gozleme-ayran-menusu.subject: A Turkish gözleme cut into pieces stacked on a wooden board, pale yufka with brown griddle spots and white cheese filling, beside it a tall clear glass of foamy white ayran yogurt drink

menemen-menusu.subject: A tray with a copper sahan pan of Turkish menemen, soft scrambled eggs fully mixed with tomato and green pepper, no whole yolks, a small basket of sliced bread and a tulip-shaped Turkish tea glass of red tea on a saucer

peynir-tabagi.subject: A wooden board of Turkish cheeses: a block of white Ezine feta, slices of aged yellow kashar, crumbly white tulum cheese, a braided örgü cheese and a nest of stringy çeçil cheese, garnished with walnuts and grapes

mantarli-kremali-makarna.subject: A wide shallow white bowl of penne pasta tubes in a creamy mushroom sauce with sautéed sliced button mushrooms, grated parmesan and chopped parsley, penne only, no flat noodles

meyhane-pilavi.subject: A white plate of Turkish meyhane pilavı, reddish-orange bulgur wheat pilaf cooked with tomato and pepper paste and mixed with browned minced beef, sprinkled with chili flakes, a small bowl of yogurt beside it

ege-kahvaltisi.subject: An Aegean Turkish breakfast spread on a light wooden table: white Ezine cheese, small black Gemlik olives, sliced tomatoes with oregano and olive oil, a plate of olive-oil wild greens, a small copper pan of menemen, bread and a Turkish tea glass

koy-kahvaltisi-kisi-basi.subject: A Turkish village breakfast for one on a wooden table: white village cheese, butter, homemade jam, two boiled village eggs, warm round bazlama flatbread, a small copper pan of round slices of dark red Turkish sucuk sausage, not pink with fried eggs, and a tulip-shaped Turkish tea glass

cacik.subject: A small white bowl of Turkish cacık, thin watery garlic yogurt soup with finely grated cucumber and chopped dill, drizzled with olive oil and dried mint, a few ice cubes floating

girit-ezmesi.subject: A small white meze plate of Girit ezmesi, a green-flecked creamy spread of white cheese mashed with plenty of chopped fresh dill, parsley and mint, crushed walnuts and pistachios on top, olive oil drizzle

lakerda.subject: A small white plate with thick pale pinkish-white slices of skinless salt-cured bonito lakerda, thin red onion rings, a drizzle of olive oil and black pepper, a lemon wedge

pancar-salatasi.subject: A small white bowl of Turkish beet salad, cubed beets folded into garlic yogurt turning it bright vivid pink-magenta, crushed walnuts on top

kasarli-mantar.subject: A small round clay dish of sautéed button mushrooms baked under a layer of fully melted bubbling golden cheese with browned spots, chopped parsley, hot and steaming

sigara-boregi.subject: A white plate of six thin golden crispy Turkish sigara börek, slim cigar-shaped fried yufka rolls with white cheese and parsley filling visible at one cut end, a sprig of parsley

ayvalik-tostu.subject: A Turkish Ayvalık toast: a long half loaf of bread pressed and toasted, cut open showing layers of sucuk, salami, sausage, melted kashar cheese, pickles, tomato and creamy Russian salad, ketchup and mayonnaise drizzled, on a wooden board

beyaz-peynirli-tost.subject: A Turkish pressed toastie cut diagonally into two triangles on a white plate, golden toasted bread, filled with crumbly white feta cheese, tomato slices and dried oregano visible at the cut, the cheese is white not yellow

hellimli-tost.subject: A closed pressed toastie cut diagonally on a white plate, golden toasted bread with press lines, slices of grilled halloumi cheese, tomato and fresh mint leaves visible at the cut

pastirmali-omlet.subject: A folded fluffy golden three-egg omelette on a white plate, the fold open to show thin slices of dark ruby-red Turkish pastırma cured beef with a reddish-brown spice crust on the edge, not salami, not sausage and melted cheese inside, tomato slices beside it
